name: ominous lockbox
mana cost: {1}{U}
types: artifact clue
replacement: as CARDNAME enters, secretly choose a number between 1 and 20.
activated[1]: {2}, sacrifice CARDNAME: draw a card.
triggered: when an opponent casts a spell with mana value equal to the chosen number, sacrifice CARDNAME. if you do, copy that spell, and you may choose new targets for the copy.
